t: The Timeguard SLB2301 is a robust indoor and outdoor PIR and photocell sensor, perfect for controlling external lighting and security lights. Its pan-and-tilt head allows precise adjustment of the detection zone, making it ideal for new installations or retrofits in various settings. Features include manual override, adjustable time delay, lux level, and PIR sensitivity, ensuring versatile performance. Push-fit terminals provide quick, hassle-free installation. This sensor handles up to 2000W resistive and 400W LED loads, with an IP65 rating for reliable operation in outdoor environments. 180° detection up to 12m at a mounting height of 2.5m. Suitable for 2000W Halogen, 400W LED/Fluorescent or 200W CFL.
